decryptionPolling.serverRetryAfter: respected; can lengthen the effective interval

energyRepresentation.computation: All encrypted values use euint128; integer arithmetic wraps modulo 2^128.
energyRepresentation.dataset: Synthetic readings; acquisition interval and physical meter validation are outside this benchmark.

studyScope: observable operational performance of public Sepolia deployments; not isolated TFHE computation

methodology.clock: performance.now (monotonic client clock); ISO wall time is metadata only
methodology.confirmation: Before prepared transaction broadcast invocation to observation of its successful receipt (1 inclusion confirmation; not finality); signing and gas estimation precede the barrier
methodology.completion: Prepared broadcast invocation to equality-validated plaintext; input preparation, transaction preparation and barrier wait excluded and recorded separately
methodology.postReceipt: receipt observation to validated plaintext, including handle read, authorization and SDK decrypt
methodology.sdkPolling: SDK retrieval includes service-directed polling and retry waits; Zama progress records retryAfterMs and CoFHE poll events record intervalMs. These are polling hints, not measured sleep durations, and must not be subtracted to infer backend computation time
methodology.alreadyReady: second authenticated SDK decrypt of the same known-ready handle, measured separately
methodology.caching: fresh encrypted input each round; ready-repeat service caches cannot be excluded; Zama uses fresh keypairs, CoFHE reuses a setup ACP
methodology.warmup: all operation paths initialized before measurement; EIP-2929 cold accesses still apply per transaction
methodology.sequencing: One persistent OS process, signer and nonce cursor per platform; sequential deployment/setup; all encrypted inputs and signed transactions prepared before a shared timed submission barrier; all workers settle before the next operation
methodology.baseline: same transaction/getter/equality endpoint, with plaintext returned directly; encryption and authenticated decryption are not applicable
methodology.temporalControl: nearby operation-matched comparisons and balanced order reduce, but cannot eliminate, public-network load and slot-phase confounding
methodology.receiptPolling: Immediate eth_getTransactionReceipt, then 500 ms waits after pending responses; raw broadcast acknowledgement is separate; only receipt reads can retry
methodology.resultRead: EIP-1898 eth_call pinned to the receipt block hash with requireCanonical=true; no latest-state fallback
methodology.deploymentBytecodeRead: EIP-1898 eth_getCode pinned to deployment receipt block hash; transport errors retried up to five attempts and block-not-found propagation errors retried within the original setup deadline; every attempt retained; empty code and non-canonical blocks fail
methodology.retrievalRetry: up to five read/retrieval attempts on transport errors, Zama SDK user-decrypt ACL check denials or HTTP 503 USER_DECRYPT responses (including SDK schema errors); receipt-block-not-found and the specific 503 gateway ciphertext-not-ready USER_DECRYPT response can retry beyond five attempts within the original observation deadline; receipt reads always use the same canonical block hash, without latest fallback; exponential backoff capped at 8 seconds; Zama attempts receive only the remaining time budget; every attempt and wait included in timing and traces; persistent failures still abort; never retry application mutations, other authorization errors or plaintext mismatches
methodology.ancillaryFailure: Separate view_decrypt observations run after max in each round; failures stop the campaign after workers settle and remain recorded. Legacy already-ready repeats are disabled.
methodology.sdkStages: client-observed API boundaries, NOT pure internal service compute durations
methodology.previews: eth_call symbolic simulations only; no persisted coprocessor request and no completion claim
methodology.fhenixWorkload: mul_scalar encrypts the constant; mean encrypts divisor 2, unlike Zama plaintext scalar operations
methodology.broadcast: Exactly one eth_sendRawTransaction per signed operation; predetermined hash journaled before barrier release; start and acknowledgement recorded separately; failed acknowledgement is uncertain and never automatically retransmitted
methodology.feeControl: One recorded EIP-1559 fee quote shared by all platforms per comparison; gas estimated and transaction signed before the barrier
methodology.fullLifecycle: preparationMs + transactionToValidatedPlaintextMs excludes intentional barrier waiting; worker wall time also includes the barrier and must be labeled separately
methodology.processIsolation: Separate Node processes isolate SDK main-thread proof generation; OS scheduling and shared CPU/RPC/network contention remain possible
methodology.viewDecrypt: Once after max in every round including warmup; concurrent persisted getLastResult eth_call at the max receipt block plus fresh SDK authorized decryption and equality validation, one shared observation deadline per worker; all waits retained; no transaction or arithmetic preview.
